quests.title: An Ode to Yonder City

dialogue.t: Truly, Liyue feels... a little too different.
All is well, all is well...
Oh, it's you, Traveler. So, there was a big incident in the city earlier, right?
Well, it's well that nothing untoward happened afterward... And more importantly, it's well that all the food stalls in the city are still open.
I mean, what would become of all those delicacies I enjoyed otherwise...

dialogue.sit: Ah, so it's about eating, then...

dialogue.t: Hey, don't you look down on it. The quickest way to know if a place is good or not is to see how its cuisine tastes.
Ah, just talking about this is making me hungry again. Maybe I should go get a little something...
Ah, all this talking is making me hungry. What should I eat...
The more I hear of this opera, the less I understand it...
Why, hello there, Traveler. Well, here's the problem: Heyu Tea House has released a few new operas lately.
But they're— Well, they're most lively, that's for sure. But I do not quite comprehend them, or how the young people seem to enjoy it so very much.

dialogue.sit: And how do you feel about that?

dialogue.t: That's a good question. Personally, I don't mind hearing some old classics. They're what I'm used to, after all.
But at the same time, Liyue Harbor is undergoing so many changes. A few new operas seem to fit the reigning mood just fine, too.
*sigh* Still, these changes feel all too swift. The old operas haven't played in a while. I wonder what Rex Lapis would— No, let us not speak of that...
*sigh* How quickly this city changes...
What have you learned, my liege?
Oh, verily? Please, do share.

dialogue.sit: There are lots of dogs by the south wharf.

dialogue.t: Oh, good, good. Most lively indeed.

dialogue.sit: The Bubu Pharmacy hosts many finches nearby.

dialogue.t: Finches, yes... A sign of peaceful times. Lovely poetic imagery.
Haha, there is nothing wrong with that. Eating is one of the prime needs and joys of life — especially in a city such as Liyue Harbor.
Yes, this too is quite fascinating. I will record this. It may yet be of use.

dialogue.sit: Some feel that things are changing too quickly.

dialogue.t: Hmm, that too is as we should expect. To some, Liyue must almost seem to be shedding its skin with every passing day. Even I find it hard to keep up or accept every single shift...
But this is a matter most broad — I fear that a single poem may not capture it adequately. Still, I shall write it down.
That should do for now. I see that I chose wisely in seeking your aid, my liege.
I believe that this will add at least a few new entries to my next anthology.
Ah, yes, apart from some material goods, I have also prepared a little gift for you. Please take it as thanks for your succour.
Once my new anthology is published, you may exchange this signature for a free copy.

quests.description: Liyue’s crisis has settled down, but it has brought a wave of change to the city. The poet Qingzhou would like to capture these shifts in verse…
